None of these represent malicious behavior—they are standard package metadata fields. The build(), check(), and package() functions are defined but never invoked by `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. Therefore, running this command will not execute any harmful code, perform any unauthorized actions, or exfiltrate data.

The file contains no command substitution, no external downloads, no system modifications, and no obfuscated payloads. It is a typical AUR PKGBUILD template with no supply-chain risks relevant to this narrow safety gate.
</details>
